issues.title: Intake On Maintenance record calculate Repair Time (Field Level)
issues.description:
On Maintenance record calculate 'Repair Time (Field Level)' based on the calculation:
Repair Time (Field Level) = Repair stop time - Repair start time

Also calculate the 'Admin delay time' based on the calculation:
Admin delay time = Repair start time - Fault date/time
